end

requirement: Configure R1 with a hostname and an encrypted enable secret password to protect privileged EXEC mode access.
configuration:
! R1
configure terminal
hostname R1
enable secret Cisco@2024
end

configuration:
! R2
configure terminal
hostname R2
enable secret Cisco@2024
service password-encryption
end

requirement: Assign the hostname R3 to the router and create a local user account with privilege 15 for secure CLI access.
configuration:
! R3
configure terminal
hostname R3
username admin privilege 15 secret AdminPass1
end

requirement: Configure the hostnames SW1 and SW2 on their respective switches so they are identifiable in the campus topology.
configuration:
! SW1
configure terminal
hostname SW1
end
!

hostname SW2
end

requirement: Add a static route on R1 so it can reach the 10.0.2.0/24 LAN segment behind R3 by forwarding traffic to R2 at 10.0.12.2.
configuration:
! R1
configure terminal
ip route 10.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.12.2
end

requirement: Configure a static default route on R1 pointing to R2 at 10.0.12.2 so all unknown destinations use R2 as the gateway of last resort.
configuration:
! R1
configure terminal
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.0.12.2
end

requirement: Add a static route on R3 so it can reach h1's subnet 10.0.1.0/24 by forwarding to R2 at 10.0.23.1.
configuration:
! R3
configure terminal
ip route 10.0.1.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.23.1
end

requirement: Configure static routes on both R1 and R3 so each router can reach the other's LAN segment using R2 as the transit path.
configuration:
! R1
configure terminal
ip route 10.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.12.2
end
!
! R3
configure terminal
ip route 10.0.1.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.23.1
end

requirement: Configure R4 with static routes toward both LAN segments: 10.0.1.0/24 via R1 at 10.0.14.1 and 10.0.2.0/24 via R3 at 10.0.34.2.
On R2, add static routes to reach h1's subnet 10.0.1.0/24 through R1 and h2's subnet 10.0.2.0/24 through R3.
Configure a floating static route on R1 for 10.0.2.0/24 via R4 at 10.0.14.2 with administrative distance 210 to serve as a backup when the primary path via R2 is unavailable.
configuration:
! R1
configure terminal
ip route 10.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.14.2 210
end

requirement: On R1, add static routes to 10.0.23.0/24 and 10.0.2.0/24 both via next-hop 10.0.12.2 on R2 to ensure reachability through the R2 transit segment.
Configure a static default route on R3 toward R2 and a static default route on R4 toward R1 so both have a gateway of last resort for non-directly-connected destinations.
configuration:
! R3
configure terminal
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.0.23.1
end
!
! R4
configure terminal
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.0.14.1
end

requirement: Add a static route on R1 for the 10.0.34.0/24 subnet reachable through R4 Ethernet0/0 at address 10.0.14.2.
configuration:
! R1
configure terminal
ip route 10.0.34.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.14.2
end

requirement: Enable OSPF process 1 on R1 and use network statements to include all three directly connected subnets in area 0.
configuration:
! R1
configure terminal
router ospf 1
 network 10.0.1.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.0.12.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.0.14.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
end

requirement: Configure OSPF process 1 on R2 to advertise all three point-to-point subnets connected to Ethernet0/0, Ethernet0/1, and Ethernet0/2 into area 0.
configuration:
! R2
configure terminal
router ospf 1
 network 10.0.12.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.0.23.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.0.24.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
end

requirement: Enable OSPF process 1 on R3 for all connected subnets in area 0 and suppress OSPF hellos on Ethernet0/2 using passive-interface so LAN hosts do not receive OSPF traffic.
configuration:

configure terminal
router ospf 1
 network 10.0.23.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.0.34.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 passive-interface Ethernet0/2
end

requirement: Configure OSPF process 1 on R4, advertising all three point-to-point subnets 10.0.14.0/24, 10.0.24.0/24, and 10.0.34.0/24 into area 0.

end

router ospf 1

 network 10.0.14.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
end

end

 network 10.0.24.0 0.0.0.255 area 0

requirement: Configure OSPF process 1 on R2, set the hello-interval to 5 seconds and dead-interval to 20 seconds on Ethernet0/0 to tune convergence timing with R1.

exit
interface Ethernet0/0

end

end

configure terminal
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
end
!

configure terminal
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst

end

! SW1
configure terminal
interface FastEthernet0/1
 spanning-tree portfast

end

configuration:
! SW2

interface FastEthernet0/1
 spanning-tree portfast

end

configuration:
! SW1
configure terminal
interface FastEthernet0/24
 spanning-tree guard root
end

configuration:
! SW1
configure terminal
interface FastEthernet0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport port-security

end

end

end

end

end

 no shutdown
interface Ethernet0/1

 no shutdown

 passive-interface Ethernet0/0
end
